STATEMENT: For any positive real numbers \(a\), \(b\), and \(c\) such that \(b^2 - 4ac < 0\), the polynomial \(ax^2 + bx + c\) has no real roots and \(a(x - \alpha)^2 + \beta > 0\) for all real \(x\), where \(\alpha = -\frac{b}{2a}\) and \(\beta = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\).
